Screening for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
US Preventive Services Task Force Reaffirmation
Recommendation Statement
US Preventive Services Task Force
Summary of Recommendation
See the Summary of Recommendation Figure.
POPULATION Asymptomatic adults who do not recognize or report respiratory symptoms.

The USPSTF decided to use a reaffirmation deliberation process to
update this recommendation. The USPSTF uses the reaffirmation
process for well-established, evidence-based standards of practice.
In its 2016 deliberation the USPSTF reached the same conclusion.
